description: Tipo de objetivo (como se usa en el diccionario de objetivos)
Clasificación de nivel superior de target_type, permitiendo agrupar, por ejemplo, todos los objetivos 'PROTEIN', todos los objetivos 'NON-MOLECULAR', etc.

sample_rows.descripción del objetivo: Target has been identified as a defined molecular entity (e.g., protein or nucleic acid)
Target has not been defined at a molecular level, only the non-molecular entity which is affected (e.g., organism, cell line etc)
Target is a fusion of two different proteins, either a synthetic construct or naturally occurring fusion protein
Target is a defined protein complex, consisting of multiple subunits
